description: Send the first message to a seller about a listing — opens a new Jiji chat thread. Use after search_suggest with listing ids.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

step_64_body_advert_id.description: Advert id from listing search results (results[].id).

step_64_body_text.description: Opening message to the seller (e.g. Is this available?).

step_64_url_path_4.description: Seller user_id from search results (results[].user_id) with .json suffix, e.g. 3956682.json.

name: start_chat
